newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Philippine Q1 private sector credit growth 37 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Q1 private sector credit growth 37 pct.

text.p: Philippine private sector credit grew by 37 percent in the first three months of 1997 compared with 57 percent real growth in all of 1996, Philippine Central Bank Governor Gabriel Singson said on Thursday in Hong Kong.
Singson said it was important to compare these figures with comparable rates in other countries such as Thailand and Malaysia.
"Total credit growth in these countries had been about 90 percent in the last three months," he said.
